qa_pair.question: Using the name lookup tool, resolve the FEC presidential candidate whose name matches "Obama, Barack" for his 2008/2012 campaigns. What is his 9-character FEC candidate ID?
Look up the committee named "ActBlue" (the Democratic online contribution-processing conduit). What is its FEC committee ID?
In the OpenFEC committee master data, a Super PAC (an independent-expenditure-only committee) is identified by a single-letter committee_type code. Which code letter identifies these committees?
When searching committees, which single-letter designation code identifies a candidate's principal campaign committee?
In the independent-expenditures tool (Schedule E), a record's support_oppose_indicator can be one of two letters. Which letter indicates the expenditure was made to OPPOSE the candidate?
When filtering FEC filings, which form type identifies the periodic financial report filed by a presidential campaign committee?

The itemized contribution and disbursement tools (Schedules A and B) do not use page numbers because the datasets are too large. What pagination field name does a response return that must be passed back to retrieve the next block of results in this server?
To bound an itemized Schedule A contribution query to the 2023-2024 election cycle, what integer value should be supplied for the two_year_transaction_period parameter?
In the candidate search tool, which single-letter value of the office filter restricts results to candidates for the U.S. Senate?
Look up the committee "WinRed" (the Republican online contribution-processing conduit) by name. What is its FEC committee ID?
